blocks.content:
Act: 2002
Operational: 2009
HQ: New Delhi
Replaced MRTP Commission
Regulates Cartels & Mergers
Replaced MRTP Commission Regulates Cartels & Mergers

items: Crucial distinction: Act was passed in 2002, but became Operational in 2009.
Frequently asked question: The body replaced by this Act is the MRTP Commission.
Core regulatory purview covers Cartels & Mergers.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Act was established in 2002 and became fully operational in 2009.
The official headquarters are located in New Delhi.
Directly replaced the former Monopolies and Restrictive Trade Practices (MRTP) Commission.
Main responsibility includes regulating anti-competitive practices like Cartels and Mergers.
